newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila share index ends up 1.04 pct at 3,160.76.
newsitem.headline: Manila share index ends up 1.04 pct at 3,160.76.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index ended up 32.38 points, or 1.04 percent, at the day's high of 3,160.76 on Wednesday, boosted mainly by blue-chips Ayala Land and San Miguel B.
Ayala Land rose one peso, or 3.45 percent, to 30 pesos on a volume of 994,600 shares.
San Miguel B, among the most active shares during the day, rose four pesos to 114.
"For San Miguel, the worst is over," Raul Ruiz of Sun Hung Kai Securities said referring to the brewery's troubles this year when high raw material costs affected profits.

He said brokers anticipated that San Miguel would post more positive results in 1997. Most buyers were foreign fund managers and they also focused on other blue-chips, fuelling the rise in Ayala Land as well, he said.

Predictions on future trends in the index varied with one broker seeing profit-taking setting in at 3,180 while another said he expected a virtually uninterrupted rise until 3,250 to the end of the week. -UDAY KHANDEPARKAR (632) 841 8934
